prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 16:9 blog cover for "Night of the Dead multiplayer, if redesigned today", sixth cover in an existing optimization series.
Input images: Image 1 is the Steady Spiral mascot identity reference. Image 2 is soft clay material and warm lighting reference only. Image 3 is the series master for character proportions, palette, scale and miniature survival-game atmosphere. All inputs are references; generate a NEW scene.
Primary request: Show the friendly snail thoughtfully designing the game's underlying structure from the beginning, using a miniature modular foundation as a visual metaphor. ONE mascot assembles a small survival-base diorama on an orderly beige modular planning board, instead of adding more pieces on top of a completed fort.
Subject invariants: exactly one chunky dark forest-green Steady Spiral snail with a lime yellow-green spiral shell, TWO rounded thick antennae, flat ivory oval eyes and a small ivory smile. Match reference identity faithfully; a small round clay hand can handle the model.
Scene: a compact beige square foundation tray directly below the snail's face, containing a small arrangement of clean removable square tiles with shallow sockets. The snail is gently fitting ONE square module bearing a small wooden watchtower into the central open socket. A few matching modules are already seated beside it: a tiny beige barricade/base hut and one small tray of orderly grey-green zombie figurines. This is a tangible miniature architectural planning model, not a literal depiction of engine internals. At most two small sage pine trees at the periphery connect it to the same survival-game world.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, slightly elevated three-quarter view. The face is near horizontal center above the planning tray; the hand, lifted watchtower module and its open socket lie in a compact vertical group centered around x=50%, not far to either side. Face and ALL essential assembly interaction within central 20% of canvas width and central 75% of height, so a tall narrow center crop keeps the theme. Shell may extend right outside that narrow crop, but remains visible in full canvas. Main character and board within middle 55% width; generous empty ivory background at both edges. No split panels or before/after layout.
Style: premium soft matte handcrafted clay 3D, rounded sculpted miniatures, warm ivory seamless studio backdrop, diffuse upper-left warm lighting, gentle contact shadows, restrained sage and beige miniature palette. Same friendly scale and finish as the series master.
Text: no title, words, letters, code, numbers, labels, arrows or watermark.
Technical constraints: evoke a proposed redesign and deliberate modular structure; no measured speedup, guaranteed performance, checkmarks, shields, magical automatic networking or complete proven migration. Do not portray this as a literal technical diagram. No envelopes, question marks, tangled cables, gears, robots or extra mascots. No gore or realistic horror.
